components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud control; only the active action wears Toast Crust.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance:none; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; padding:9px 15px; font:600 13px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; background:#e07a2b; color:#2b1d0f; cursor:pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#e89b60; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2a2622; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; fills with sand on hover.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Toggle; off = Sand Track, on = Toast Crust; ink outline on focus.
components.css: .ds-switch{position:relative;display:inline-flex;width:42px;height:24px;} .ds-switch input{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;margin:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;} .ds-switch-track{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:999px;background:#e3d7c6;transition:background 160ms ease;} .ds-switch-thumb{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(42,38,34,.25);transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1);} .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track{background:#e07a2b;} .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track .ds-switch-thumb{transform:translateX(18px);} .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track{outline:2px solid #2a2622;outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Focus Ring
components.description: Signature timer: a conic Toast Crust sweep around a cream disc.

narrative.overview: The Den is a paper den — a desk corner made of cream paper scraps, ruled hairline lines, and ink handwriting. Mochi's fur (the pet's own cream and ink) is the material the UI borrows; warmth comes from tonal paper-on-paper layering, not decoration. The one loud thing in the room is the orange, which carries every active, running, worn signal — and never decorates. Feel is playful and bright, but small: roundness, bouncy micro-motion in the pet's own easing vocabulary, tabular timer digits. The calm comes from what it never does — it never shouts, never judges, never steals focus.
keyCharacteristics: Paper on paper — cream cards floating on cream paper, separated by soft shadows, not lines
One voice — a single orange (Toast Crust) given all active meaning, in any theme
Pet-derived palette — cosmetic colors are the pet's own cream/ink plus its worn accessories
System type, tabular digits — Segoe UI everywhere, every ticking number tabular
Soft geometry — nothing sharper than a 9px corner
Motion in the pet's vocabulary — 80–400ms, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); never fights the reduced-motion kill-switch

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Toast Crust appears only where something is active, running, or worn — never as decoration, never on more than ~10% of a screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Property-Color Rule
rules.body: Moss, sky and aurora belong to the pet. If a UI element wears a scarf color, the pet must be able to wear it too.

rules.name: The Tabletop Rule
rules.body: Every number that ticks — timers, meters, stats, XP — uses tabular numerals. A jittering digit is a bug.

rules.name: The Lift-By-Tone Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from soft warm shadows and tonal paper steps. Never add a border for depth, never a shadow darker than rgba(…, 0.35).

dos: Do use Toast Crust for state, never decoration; pair it with card-cream or Crust Bold text.
Do keep all countable numbers tabular (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).
Do keep keyboard visibility ink-black (2px, offset 2px) on every interactive element; Crust outlines on cream for text fields only.
Do draw cosmetic icons and Locker swatches from the pet's own palette at full strength, in any theme.
Do use the motion vocabulary: 80ms press, 120–200ms state, 300–400ms entrances; pronounce tab changes as a 180ms 6px rise.
Do keep light and dark as the same den at dusk: same structure, same roles, hue-matched.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent or a blue/link color.
Don't dim text with opacity to signal unavailable — retheme the tile instead; Mushroom is already at its readability floor.
Don't add pure white or pure black; the palette starts at #fffdf8 and ends at #221d18.
Don't sharpen a corner below 9px or add square corners to anything round.
Don't animate anything <80ms or >400ms, and never without respecting the reduced-motion kill-switch.
Don't put an eyebrow-styled span where a real heading is needed — structure is not a style.
